keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «뒤에서 문이 닫혀 둘이 갇혀 버렸다(문제)» 와 «신중하게 생각한 덕분에 레오가 비밀 출구를 찾았다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the door closed behind them and they were trapped) and the solution (careful thinking helped Leo find the secret way out). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: They were trapped in a tunnel inside a pyramid.
Leo read the wall pictures and pushed a stone with a sun on it.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: Leo and his aunt were exploring a
in Egypt. A secret door closed behind them, and they were
. Leo saw that every picture showed a bird flying toward the
. He pushed a stone with a sun on it, and they climbed out into the
just as the light went out.

words: Leo and his aunt were exploring a pyramid in Egypt.
a big stone building with four sloping sides
a long path under the ground or through rock
Their flashlight was getting weaker and weaker.
a small light that you hold in your hand
helped Leo find the secret way out.
hidden and not known by others

qs.q: Why did the secret door open?
opts: Leo leaned on a stone, and it moved.
His aunt found a golden key.
A bird flew into the pyramid.
evs: Leo leaned on a stone, and it moved with a loud click.
Every picture showed a bird flying toward the sun.
Leo and his aunt were exploring a pyramid in Egypt.
They climbed out into the desert just as the light went out.
why: 레오가 돌 하나에 기대자 딸깍 소리와 함께 돌이 움직였고, 그러자 비밀 문이 열렸어요. 열쇠를 찾았다는 말은 없어요.
Leo leaned on a stone, and it moved with a loud click. Then the secret door opened. Nothing says they found a key.

qs.q: The story says, "Their flashlight was getting weaker and weaker." What does this mean?
qs.qko: "Their flashlight was getting weaker and weaker."라는 문장이 있어요. 이 말은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: Its light was slowly going out.
It was getting heavier to carry.
evs: They climbed out into the desert just as the light went out.
Inside, the air was hot, and the walls had pictures.
Leo looked closely at the pictures.
A secret door opened, and they walked down a narrow tunnel.
why: 손전등 빛이 점점 약해지다가, 둘이 사막으로 나오는 순간 꺼졌어요. «weaker and weaker»는 빛이 조금씩 줄어든다는 뜻이에요.
The flashlight got dimmer and finally went out just as they climbed out. «Weaker and weaker» means the light was slowly going out.

qs.q: How did Leo know which stone to push?
qs.qko: 레오는 어떤 돌을 밀어야 하는지 어떻게 알았나요?
opts: The pictures showed a bird flying toward the sun, so he looked for the sun.
His aunt told him the answer.
He heard a click behind the stone.
evs: Every picture showed a bird flying toward the sun.
Suddenly, the door closed behind them. They were trapped!
"Maybe the way out is where the sun is," Leo said.
"You read the walls like a real scientist!" his aunt said.
why: 모든 그림에 해를 향해 날아가는 새가 있었고, 레오는 «나가는 길은 해가 있는 쪽일지도 몰라»라고 생각했어요. 그래서 해가 새겨진 돌을 밀었어요.
Every picture showed a bird flying toward the sun, and Leo thought the way out might be where the sun is. So he pushed the stone with a sun on it.

ends: Leo and his aunt go back with a museum team to study the pictures.
레오와 이모가 박물관 팀과 함께 다시 가서 벽 그림을 연구해요.
Leo makes his own picture book about the bird and the sun.
레오가 새와 해에 대한 자기만의 그림책을 만들어요.

write.src: “Let’s <u>read the pictures on the wall</u> before <u>the flashlight goes out</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what to do together and what happens later in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 써 보세요. (예: before the sun goes down)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write who + what. (e.g. before the sun goes down)

img.cover: In a narrow stone tunnel inside a pyramid, a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, a khaki explorer shirt with many pockets, brown shorts and a small blue backpack pushes a wall stone carved with a round sun, and a door slides open with bright desert sunlight pouring in, while his aunt, a tall woman with a long dark braid, a wide sun hat and a light green jacket holds a dim flashlight and smiles.

scenes.1: A ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, a khaki explorer shirt with many pockets, brown shorts and a small blue backpack and his aunt, a tall woman with a long dark braid, a wide sun hat and a light green jacket walk down a narrow stone tunnel inside a pyramid with a weak flashlight, as a heavy stone door slides shut behind them in a cloud of dust.
scenes.2: By the dim light of a flashlight, a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, a khaki explorer shirt with many pockets, brown shorts and a small blue backpack looks closely at wall paintings that all show a bird flying toward a round yellow sun, with no writing on the walls, while his aunt, a tall woman with a long dark braid, a wide sun hat and a light green jacket leans in to look too.

alt.1: A stone door closes behind a boy and his aunt in a dark tunnel.
alt.2: A boy studies wall pictures of a bird flying to the sun.
alt.cover: A boy pushes a sun stone, and a door opens to the desert.
